general.title: Malaysia Exports Hit Record High in October on AI-Related Demand
general.summary: Malaysia’s exports hit a record high in October, growing at the fastest pace in more than five years on sustained demand for AI-related products.

general.title: Yen Outperforms G-10 Peers as Tech Selloff Fuels Haven Demand
general.summary: The yen led gains among Group of 10 currencies on Friday as investors sought havens amid a deepening selloff in technology stocks that has spilled into Asia trading.

general.title: Treasuries Eye Longest Rally in Five Months on Haven Demand
general.summary: Treasuries are headed for their longest rally in almost five months, as mounting doubts over the artificial intelligence trade deepen a global stock selloff and drive investors toward haven assets.

general.title: Pakistan Minister Makes Rare India Visit for Regional Forum
general.summary: Pakistan’s Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik arrived in New Delhi Friday for a two-day regional forum, the first such high-level visit since 2023, though it signals no broader thaw in ties between the neighbors.

general.title: PBOC Anchors Yuan With Stable Fix as Volatility Jumps After APEC
general.summary: China’s central bank signaled it wants to curb sharp moves in the yuan with a largely steady fixing Friday, after the currency posted its biggest drop since March following a trilateral leaders’ meeting.

general.title: AI Spurs Funding Needs as Top Japan Power Producer Weighs IPO
general.summary: Japan’s biggest electricity producer said the artificial intelligence boom is supporting the case for investment in the power sector as it considers ways to raise funds for expansion, including a possible initial public offering.

general.title: Senate passes BAAJA permitting reform bill backed by AI, energy sectors
general.summary: The permitting bill's Senate passage is a key step to it becoming law, but it would also need to clear the House before heading to President Trump's desk.

general.title: China Solar Cell Exports Rise for Second Month on Tariff Rush
general.summary: China’s solar cell exports expanded for a second month in October as overseas buyers rushed to stock up before US tariffs on polysilicon take effect in early December.

general.title: NZ Central Bank’s Chief Economist Urges Government to Stop Messing With Mandate
general.summary: Reserve Bank of New Zealand Chief Economist Paul Conway called on future finance ministers to stop tinkering with the central bank’s mandate, warning that repeated changes affect how monetary policy is conducted.

general.title: SoftBank plunges over 16% as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks following Anthropic debut
general.summary: The declines in Asia come after the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite fell more than 2% overnight following Anthropic's highly anticipated Wall Street debut.

general.title: Nextdc Says It Will No Longer Develop Data Centers Near Homes
general.summary: Australian data center company Nextdc has vowed not to develop sites near residential areas after community opposition and power constraints delayed a major expansion project.

general.title: Hong Kong Stocks Fall 20% From 2026 High as AI Selloff Spreads
general.summary: Hong Kong stocks fell toward a grim milestone as an AI-led selloff spread to engulf even the more defensive corners of the market.

general.title: Sri Lanka Unexpectedly Raises Key Rate to Combat Inflation
general.summary: Sri Lanka’s central bank unexpectedly raised its benchmark interest rate, stepping up its fight against inflation even as easing global oil prices offer some relief from price pressures.

general.title: AI Trade Buckles as Taiwan Stocks Suffer Worst Week in 35 Years
general.summary: Anthropic PBC’s blockbuster IPO is becoming a catalyst for a savage selloff across artificial intelligence stocks.

general.title: Court Upholds Kakao Founder’s Acquittal of Stock Rigging Charges
general.summary: A South Korean appeals court upheld the acquittal of Kakao Corp. founder Brian Kim on stock manipulation charges, clearing a major legal overhang at a critical juncture for the internet empire he built.

general.title: Emerging-Market Stocks Head for Bear Market on AI-Led Tech Slide
general.summary: Emerging-market stocks are set to enter a bear market as a slide in artificial intelligence shares, concern about rising global interest rates and trade tensions weigh on investor sentiment.

general.summary: Anthropic PBC shares are headed for a weak open on their second day of trading, swept up in a broad market selloff as fears over the outlook for the artificial intelligence trade outweighed any optimism from the company’s record debut.

general.summary: On the Power On podcast, Joanna Stern joins Mark Gurman to discuss Nvidia’s leadership fallout, Apple’s executive culture under Steve Jobs and Tim Cook and why Cupertino isn’t immune. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: AMD dives on short seller report of alleged China exposure
general.summary: AMD closed down over 7% after a short seller alleged that its firmware showed up at a blacklisted Chinese company. AMD said it complies with U.S. law.

general.title: UK Consumers Become More Willing to Spend, GfK Survey Finds
general.summary: British consumers regained their appetite for splashing out on things such as furniture and electronics in November, according to a survey that provides some relief for retailers ahead of crucial festive season.
